description: This file defines the interface 'ModifyFeaturesLiveCommand', which extends multiple interfaces related to live commands for modifying feature sets associated with 'things' in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides a method to access the features to be modified.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturesLiveCommand
classes.description: Interface providing access to a live command for modifying features of a thing, including retrieving the features to modify and inheriting behavior from related command interfaces.

methods.name: getFeatures
methods.description: Returns the new Features object to be used for modification.
